gloss: to spread; to diffuse; to go viral

definitions.gloss: to spread; to go viral; to share widely (online)
definitions.explanation: To spread information, images, or content widely, especially through social media. In modern usage, often means to repost or share content so it reaches many people.

definitions.gloss: to diffuse; to disperse; to scatter
definitions.explanation: In scientific and technical contexts, the physical process of particles, substances, or energy spreading out through a medium.

examples.japanese: この{情報|じょうほう}を{拡散|かくさん}してください。
{動画|どうが}がSNSで{一気|いっき}に{拡散|かくさん}された。
examples.english: The video went viral on social media all at once.

examples.japanese: デマが{拡散|かくさん}しないように{注意|ちゅうい}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: We need to be careful so that false rumors don't spread.

examples.japanese: {光|ひかり}がレンズで{拡散|かくさん}する。
{汚染物質|おせんぶっしつ}が{広範囲|こうはんい}に{拡散|かくさん}した。
examples.english: The contaminants dispersed over a wide area.

examples.japanese: {核兵器|かくへいき}の{拡散|かくさん}を{防|ふせ}ぐための{条約|じょうやく}がある。
examples.english: There is a treaty to prevent the proliferation of nuclear weapons.

notes: Can be used both transitively ({情報|じょうほう}を{拡散|かくさん}する, to spread information) and intransitively ({情報|じょうほう}が{拡散|かくさん}する, information spreads). The online sense (sense 1) has become very common in daily usage — {拡散希望|かくさんきぼう} (please share/RT) is frequently seen on social media. In the political/military sense, {核拡散|かくかくさん} (nuclear proliferation) and {拡散防止|かくさんぼうし} (non-proliferation) are important terms.
